paraphrase_notes: Supports confirming release/ownership and preserving technical-system boundaries before general stagehand cable handling.
applicability_notes: Department/employer controls actual cable state and permitted handling.
required_qualifier: Do not infer release from appearance or course completion.

paraphrase_notes: Supports visible-condition recognition and reporting without technical repair/testing authority.
applicability_notes: Exact inspection criteria remain cable-family/manufacturer specific.
required_qualifier: General stagehand identifies obvious concerns and reports; technical diagnosis remains external.

paraphrase_notes: QSC demonstrates over-under as a cable-management method for common audio/production cables and explains alternating loop orientation.
applicability_notes: QSC's example does not establish universal applicability to all cable families or every department.
required_qualifier: Technician/manufacturer instructions control exceptions and cable-specific handling.

paraphrase_notes: Neutrik documents product-family-specific minimum coiling diameter requirements for opticalCON assemblies.
applicability_notes: Product-family evidence only; does not define all fiber or production-cable handling.
required_qualifier: Use exact product/manufacturer instructions for the actual assembly.

paraphrase_notes: Belden demonstrates that optical cable families can have defined bend/tension constraints and installation handling limits.
applicability_notes: Belden-specific guidance; exact assembly instructions control.
required_qualifier: Do not generalize one manufacturer's limits to another product.

paraphrase_notes: Professional testing standards support limiting interpretations to what the assessment actually demonstrates; they do not themselves define employer authorization.
required_qualifier: Observed practice is recorded only for the named task/equipment/conditions; employer authorization remains separate.
authority_owner: Crew Blueprint evidence model / employer for authorization
